name: @oxian/ominipg
description: Runtime-neutral PostgreSQL and PGlite sessions powered by Oxian workloads.
author: Ominipg

tasks.check: deno task check:portability && deno fmt --check deno.json src/session src/worker src/client/index.ts src/client/types.ts src/client/emitter.ts src/shared scripts/build_npm.ts scripts/check_portability.ts scripts/check_node_portability.mjs test/emitter.test.ts test/oxian-session.test.ts test/notifications.test.ts && deno lint src/session src/worker src/client/index.ts src/client/types.ts src/client/emitter.ts src/shared scripts/build_npm.ts scripts/check_portability.ts test/emitter.test.ts test/oxian-session.test.ts && deno check src/client/index.ts src/session/index.ts src/worker/index.ts
tasks.test:npm-node: deno task build:npm && deno run -A scripts/test_npm_node.ts
tasks.verify: deno task check && deno task test:deno && deno task test:npm-node && deno task check:publish
